_README: Runtime configuration. Keys starting with '_' (like this one) are documentation only — Pydantic ignores them. Replace every PASTE_*, FILL_*, and example placeholder below with your real values before running. Reference: see config.example.json for additional notes per section.

llm._help: provider chooses which LLM client get_llm_client() returns. 'ollama' hits a local Ollama server; 'openai' hits any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (real OpenAI, internal company gateway, vLLM, etc.).

jira._help: JIRA Data Center. token is a Personal Access Token from your JIRA profile (Settings -> Personal Access Tokens). Set verify_ssl=false for corporate self-signed certs, or point ca_bundle at your corporate CA .pem file.

confluence._help: Confluence Data Center. Same auth pattern as JIRA. retry_total kept low (1) because Confluence DC tends to apply per-token rate-limit overrides; high retries burn the token's bucket. extra_page_max_chars caps each optional context page in the Status prompt.

logging._help: JSONL logs are rotated by size. log_full_llm_prompts=true writes every LLM call's FULL system+user prompt + raw response to logs/llm_prompts.jsonl (inspect via 'manage.py show-last-llm-call'). Disable in production once prompts are stable; the compact audit trail in ai_compute.jsonl + the AIComputeLog DB table is kept either way.

email._help: SMTP is mocked in Phase 1 (mock=true). 'Sent' emails are appended to logs/sent_emails.jsonl instead of leaving the machine. Flip mock=false and fill smtp_host once a relay is available.

projects._help: REPLACE THIS EXAMPLE with your real project. Required: code, name, jira_project_key, confluence_milestones_url, confluence_fr_url. Everything else has a default. confluence_extra_pages is OPTIONAL; the AI uses listed pages as supplementary context only and may NOT derive milestones or FRs from them. Add additional projects by appending more {...} objects to this array.
projects.name: Example Project — replace with your real project name
projects.description: One-line description of the project (purpose, intended outcome).
